name: Pocket-lint

sources.title: Pocket-lint Contact — categorized inquiry form: Editorial (topic ideas, feedback), Events & PR (media inquiries), Partnership, Advertising; part of Valnet Publishing Group

requirements: Not a directory — earned editorial only; no submission form or listing product
The /contact page routes by inquiry type: 'Editorial Inquiries' for topic ideas/feedback, 'Events & PR' for media inquiries, 'Partnership' for commercial opportunities
Consumer-tech focus (devices, apps, entertainment, car tech) — a SaaS product needs a consumer-app angle
Valnet Publishing Group property — same operator as MakeUseOf and other network sites
preparation: A consumer-tech angle — app, gadget, or software story
Press release or concise pitch routed through the 'Editorial Inquiries' or 'Events & PR' category on the contact form
workflow: Choose the right inquiry category (Editorial for pitches, Events & PR for media relations)
Submit the pitch/press release via the interactive form
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written article or review — no listing page is created
watchFor: The contact page is a categorized form, not a published inbox — expect no direct email address
Valnet sites share infrastructure — identical pitches across the network may read as spam
No guest-post or contributed-content program is advertised
Reviews are staff-produced ('Our Review Methodology' page exists)
countsAsLive: A Pocket-lint article or review mentioning the product is published at pocket-lint.com
unknowns: Response times for the editorial inquiry category
Whether review-sample logistics have a separate intake
